sloka: भैरवाभिरुते भीमे युद्धे वानररक्षसाम्।भूतैर्बहुभिराकाशं विस्मितैरावृतं बभौ ।। ६.९१.६३ ।।
transliteration: bhairavābhirute bhīme yuddhe vānararakṣasām।bhūtairbahubhirākāśaṁ vismitairāvṛtaṁ babhau ।। 6.91.63 ।।

translations.english: The war between both was wonderful and horripulating. Beings from the sky saw Lakshmana diverting the Asura missile.
